limitations: The inverse-FM criterion is not claimed minimal; Hatori--Oi already obtain an order-isomorphic core under a different coarse lower-distance hypothesis. Constants inherited from their stability theorem are not claimed sharp. The exact epsilon/inf(w_n) formula is specific to the displayed diagonal c0 family. One cited 2026 Hatori--Oi manuscript on non-unital positive-cone order isomorphisms was not available for full inspection.
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
record_title: Two-sided Fischer–Muszély stability detects order-isomorphic cores
